definitions.phases: All-rank maximum host boundaries clipped to inter-compute gaps; these phases partition each gap. Overlapping envelopes have zero gap and their overlap is recorded separately.
definitions.store_times: Sum across compute transitions of the largest per-rank store call duration. Exposed clips each rank's calls to GPU gaps. These diagnostics overlap the pre-forward phase and are not additive with it; different rank maxima need not identify a single critical path.
definitions.admission_ratio: Requests admitted at any seal intersected with requests whose all-rank KV completion occurred inside any measured compute interval, divided by those ready requests. Not a per-seal optimality bound.
definitions.inference: Four descriptive repeats in an independent allocation per mode, no significance claim. Allocator avoidance and global GPU reuse fences are selected in both modes. Native D2H moves submission to a separate I/O worker with the plan's chunk size and depth two. Source access remains STREAM ordered after the caller's recorded producer. If reuse is necessary, native stores conservatively wait for actual completion on the host. Reset, lifetime and retirement remain completion based.
